name: Hook 1...mp4
speech: You can vacuum, wash your sheets, even by an air purifier, and the sneezing still comes back.
They live deep in your mattress, and they leave behind the actual thing your body reacts to.
And the thing that finally got them out of my bed? These little cards I started using a few weeks ago.
Capture cards. It's a flat card that works differently than an air purifier. Instead of just filtering
the air, it goes after the dust mites themselves, which is what was actually setting off my reactions
in the first place. A plant-derived pheromone lure pulls them up out of the mattress and the
adhesive holds them on the card. No plug, no spray. I just slid one under my mattress.
